part2.audioText: What's the fastest way to get downtown at this hour?
optionAudioTexts: The subway avoids all the traffic.
part2.explanation: What's the fastest way 問最快的方式，(A)「搭捷運可避開車潮」正確。(B) 沒有回答方式，(C) 回答時間點。

part2.audioText: When will the new hires start their orientation?
optionAudioTexts: The first Monday of next month.
part2.explanation: When 問時間，(A)「下個月第一個週一」正確。(B) 回答地點，(C) 回答人數。

part2.audioText: Isn't this the last day to submit vacation requests?
optionAudioTexts: Yes, they're due by five o'clock today.
part2.explanation: 否定疑問句確認今天是否為休假申請截止日，(B)「對，今天五點前要交」正確。

part2.audioText: Who can show me how to use the new copier?
optionAudioTexts: Ask Jenny. She's used it a lot.
part2.explanation: Who 問人，(C)「問 Jenny，她很常用」正確。(A)(B) 都與 copier 相關但沒有回答「誰」。

part2.audioText: Why did the shipment from Bangkok arrive late?
optionAudioTexts: It was held up at customs.
part2.explanation: Why 問原因，(A)「在海關被卡住了」正確。be held up = 被耽擱。(B) 數量、(C) 地點皆答非所問。

part2.audioText: Should I print the handouts in color or in black and white?
optionAudioTexts: Black and white is fine. It's cheaper.
part2.explanation: A or B 選擇疑問句，(B) 選黑白並說明原因（比較便宜），正確。(C) 選擇疑問句不能用 Yes 回答。

part2.audioText: How was the client dinner last night?
optionAudioTexts: At the steak house on Fifth Avenue.
It went really well. They signed the contract.
part2.explanation: How was...? 問狀況如何，(B)「很順利，他們簽約了」正確。(A) 地點、(C) 時間皆答非所問。

part2.audioText: You're moving to the Singapore office next month, aren't you?
optionAudioTexts: Yes, I leave on the fifth.
part2.explanation: 附加問句確認調職，(A)「對，我五號出發」正確。(B)(C) 用 office/move 相關字混淆。

script: M: Hi, I'd like two tickets for the seven o'clock showing of Ocean's Edge, please.
W: I'm sorry, sir, but the seven o'clock show is sold out. We still have seats for the nine fifteen showing.
M: Nine fifteen is a bit late for us. Are there seats for the earlier show at four thirty?
W: Let me check. Yes, there are a few left, but they're all in the front two rows.
M: Hmm, front row seats give me a headache. We'll take the nine fifteen instead. Two adults, please.
W: That'll be twenty-six dollars. If you join our free rewards program today, you'll get a free small popcorn with your purchase.

questions.q: Where does the conversation most likely take place?
questions.explanation: 買電影票、showing（場次）、popcorn 等線索顯示是電影院，故選 (A)。

questions.q: Why does the man decline the four thirty show?
options: He will still be at work.
questions.explanation: 女子說 4:30 場只剩前兩排，男子說前排座位讓他頭痛，因此不選那場，故選 (C)。

questions.q: What does the woman say about the rewards program?
options: It includes a free popcorn today.
questions.explanation: 女子說今天加入免費會員可獲得 a free small popcorn，故選 (B)。

script: W: Mr. Grant, I've finished checking the inventory in the stockroom. We're running low on the A4 copy paper and the blue ink cartridges.
M: Again? We just ordered supplies three weeks ago. Usage must be up because of the year-end audit.
W: Probably. Should I place another order with our usual supplier?
M: Actually, let's try OfficeDirect this time. Their prices are about ten percent lower, and delivery is free for orders over one hundred dollars.
W: Sounds good. I'll make sure the order is over that amount then. Anything else we need?
M: Add a box of file folders, too. And please keep the receipt so we can compare costs at the end of the quarter.

questions.q: What did the woman just do?
questions.explanation: 女子說 I've finished checking the inventory in the stockroom（清點完庫存），故選 (B)。

questions.q: Why does the man suggest OfficeDirect?
options: It is closer to the office.
questions.explanation: 男子說 Their prices are about ten percent lower（價格低約一成），且滿百免運，故選 (A)。

questions.q: What does the man ask the woman to keep?
questions.explanation: 男子最後說 please keep the receipt so we can compare costs（保留收據以便比較成本），故選 (B)。

part4.script: Welcome to the Harborton City Museum audio tour. Before you begin, here are a few reminders. Flash photography is not permitted in any of the galleries, as it can damage the artwork. However, photos without flash are welcome everywhere except the special exhibition hall on the third floor. Our current special exhibition, Treasures of the Silk Road, runs until September 30 and requires a separate ticket, which you can purchase at the information desk. If you'd like a guided tour instead, free tours in English leave from the main lobby every day at eleven and two. The museum café on the ground floor serves lunch until three, and museum members receive a fifteen percent discount there. Enjoy your visit.

questions.q: What are visitors NOT allowed to do in the galleries?
questions.explanation: Flash photography is not permitted in any of the galleries，禁止使用閃光燈拍照，故選 (B)。不用閃光燈則可拍照。

questions.q: What is mentioned about the special exhibition?
options: It is free for all visitors.
It is on the ground floor.
questions.explanation: requires a separate ticket, which you can purchase at the information desk，特展需另外購票，故選 (A)。

questions.q: What benefit do museum members receive?
questions.explanation: museum members receive a fifteen percent discount there（博物館咖啡廳），會員享 85 折，故選 (C)。

part4.script: Good afternoon, team. I called this quick meeting to share some exciting news. As you know, our mobile banking app has been nominated for the National FinTech Awards, and yesterday we learned that we made the final round in the Best User Experience category. The winners will be announced at a ceremony in the capital on August 28. The company will send four team members to attend, and management asked me to choose based on contributions to the project. I'll announce the names by Friday. In the meantime, the awards committee needs a two-minute demonstration video of the app by next Wednesday. Priya, I'd like you to lead that, since you produced our last promotional video. Everyone else, please send Priya any screen recordings you have by Monday.

options: An app reached the finals of an award.
questions.explanation: we made the final round in the Best User Experience category，App 入圍決選，故選 (B)。

options: An awards ceremony will be held.
A new app version will be released.
questions.explanation: The winners will be announced at a ceremony on August 28，頒獎典禮在 8/28 舉行，故選 (B)。

questions.q: What is Priya asked to do?
options: Lead the creation of a video
questions.explanation: I'd like you to lead that（製作兩分鐘展示影片），因為她做過宣傳影片，故選 (C)。

part5.q: Employees are reminded to wear their ID badges ------- times while in the building.
part5.explanation: at all times = 隨時、無時無刻，固定片語。「在大樓內請隨時配戴識別證」。

part5.q: The keynote speech was ------- received by the audience at the technology summit.
part5.explanation: 修飾動詞 was received 用副詞 warmly（熱烈地）。「主題演講獲得聽眾熱烈迴響」。

part5.q: ------- signing the lease, tenants should inspect the property for any damage.
part5.explanation: Prior to + V-ing/名詞 = 在…之前。「簽租約前，房客應檢查房屋是否有損壞」。

part5.q: The committee has not yet decided ------- the annual conference will be held in person or online.
part5.explanation: whether A or B = 是 A 還是 B。「委員會尚未決定年會要實體還是線上舉行」。

part5.q: Because of a system upgrade, online banking will be temporarily -------.
part5.explanation: 系統升級期間服務「暫時無法使用」，選 unavailable。accessible（可使用）語意相反。

part5.q: Dr. Meyer's research team published ------- findings in an international journal.
part5.explanation: team 是單數集合名詞，所有格用 its。「Meyer 博士的團隊在國際期刊上發表其研究成果」。

part5.q: The store's return policy allows customers to exchange items ------- thirty days of purchase.
part5.explanation: within thirty days of purchase = 購買後三十天內。within + 期間 = 在…之內。

part5.q: Attendance at the safety briefing is ------- for all visitors to the construction site.
part5.explanation: compulsory = 強制的。「所有進入工地的訪客都必須參加安全簡報」。voluntary（自願的）語意相反。

part5.q: ------- who wishes to volunteer for the charity event should sign up by Thursday.
part5.explanation: Anyone who... = 任何想…的人。「想擔任慈善活動志工者請於週四前報名」。Whoever 後不加 who。

part5.q: The manufacturing plant has operated ------- since the new equipment was installed.
part5.explanation: 修飾動詞 has operated 用副詞 smoothly（順暢地）。「自從安裝新設備後，工廠運作順暢」。

part5.q: Please confirm your attendance ------- e-mail no later than August 10.
part5.explanation: by e-mail = 以電子郵件（方式）。「請於 8/10 前以電子郵件確認出席」。

part5.q: The board approved the proposal to expand ------- the Southeast Asian market.
part5.explanation: expand into + 市場/地區 = 拓展進入…。「董事會通過進軍東南亞市場的提案」。

part6.passage:
Dear Mr. Okafor,

Thank you for speaking at last week's Regional Logistics Forum. Your presentation on supply chain automation received excellent [33] from attendees; in our survey, it was rated the most useful session of the day. We would be delighted if you could speak again at our national conference in Chicago this November. The conference [34] more than 2,000 logistics professionals each year. As a featured speaker, you would receive complimentary registration, travel reimbursement, and a speaking fee. Please let us know your availability [35] September 1 so that we can finalize the program.

Sincerely,
Conference Committee

questions.explanation: received excellent feedback = 獲得極佳的回饋。後句提到問卷中被評為最實用的場次，故選 feedback。
主詞 The conference 是第三人稱單數，且 each year 表示常態，用現在式 attracts。「每年吸引超過兩千名物流專業人士」。
by September 1 = 在 9/1 之前（期限）。「請於 9/1 前告知您是否有空」。

part6.passage:
【Notice】
Attention Gym Members

The swimming pool will be closed for its annual cleaning from Monday, August 10, through Friday, August 14. It will [36] on Saturday, August 15, at 6:00 A.M. During the closure, members may use the pool at our sister location on Grand Avenue at no extra [37]. Simply show your membership card at the front desk. Group swimming classes scheduled during the closure will be moved to the Grand Avenue pool as well. Members enrolled in these classes will receive an e-mail with [38] details by the end of this week. We appreciate your understanding.

questions.explanation: 清潔結束後泳池將於 8/15 重新開放，選 reopen。
at no extra charge = 不另外收費。「休池期間會員可免費使用姐妹分店泳池」。
further details = 更多細節，固定搭配。farther 用於實際距離。

part7.passage:
【Memo】
To: All Department Heads
From: Olivia Grant, Chief Operations Officer
Date: August 5
Subject: Flexible Work Policy — Trial Results

As you know, our company began a six-month trial of a flexible work policy in February, allowing employees to work from home up to two days per week. The trial has now ended, and I would like to share the results.

Overall, the trial was a success. Employee satisfaction scores rose by 18 percent, and voluntary resignations fell to their lowest level in four years. Productivity, measured by project completion rates, remained unchanged. The only significant concern was scheduling: some teams found it difficult to hold in-person meetings because members chose different remote days.

Therefore, starting September 1, the flexible policy will become permanent with one adjustment: each department will designate two "anchor days" per week when all team members must be in the office. Department heads should submit their chosen anchor days to me by August 20. A revised policy handbook will be distributed before the end of the month.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the memo?
options: To announce the results of a trial policy
To introduce a new department head
questions.explanation: 備忘錄分享六個月彈性工作試辦結果，並宣布政策轉為常態，故選 (A)。

questions.q: What problem occurred during the trial?
options: In-person meetings were hard to schedule.
questions.explanation: some teams found it difficult to hold in-person meetings，因大家遠端日不同難以安排實體會議，故選 (B)。生產力不變、離職率反而下降。

questions.q: What are department heads asked to do by August 20?
questions.explanation: Department heads should submit their chosen anchor days to me by August 20，8/20 前提交固定進辦公室日，故選 (A)。

questions.q: What is the purpose of the dinner?
options: To raise funds for a scholarship
questions.explanation: 邀請函註明 Proceeds support the Young Entrepreneurs Scholarship（收益支持青年創業獎學金），故選 (A)。

questions.q: How much will Mr. Liao most likely pay?
questions.explanation: 他要訂 a full table for my staff，整桌八人價為 $680，故選 (C)。

questions.q: What does Mr. Liao ask the organizers to do?
questions.explanation: 他請主辦單位確保桌位到舞台有無障礙通道（step-free access），因同事使用輪椅，故選 (A)。

questions.q: What is suggested about Mr. Liao's colleague?
questions.explanation: She has been nominated for the Rising Star award，她入圍新星獎，可能上台領獎，故選 (B)。
